name: Kango College
description: Kango College — a serif block theme for a nursing college. A first screen with a skills-lab photograph on the left and a flat wine notice card crossing the seam, then three glyph cells, a glow lead with a sideways quote strip, the teaching day in timed rows, ruled admissions and lab sections and a full-bleed building. Fraunces for headings, Source Serif 4 for reading. Warm paper, one wine accent, a soft rose glow and one lilac band. WCAG AA colours.
